label: digit 0 input at middle original positions (t=3-6)
explanation: Token detector for the digit 0 read as input during the original phase. 40602 of 40615 dev activations fall on in_tok==0. It never fires at t=0-1, in the delimiter step or the copy phase (including copy-phase echoes of 0), and almost never at t>=7. Firing rate and magnitude peak at t=3-5. Within the 0 inputs it is gated by context: it is stronger when 0 is the first occurrence of that token, when the sequence already holds other digits, and when earlier tokens are w/k/t/v (top examples begin with w k ...). Only about 20% of all 0 inputs activate, so precision is incomplete; much of the slack comes from 0 at t=2 or t>=7 and from weak-context sequences.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: 0, n, -, w, m, z; least: e, g, k, p) and the first original token (most: w, t, k, v, o, p; least: y, f, 0, h); timing cues that raise it most: t=4, t=3, t=5.
